stem: Why does the playwright include a narrator in this play?

options.label: A
options.text: To make the main character's conflict seem more suspenseful

options.label: B
options.text: To help the audience understand what the characters are thinking

options.label: C
options.text: To assist the main characters in figuring out how to solve a problem

options.label: D
options.text: To give the audience details about the characters' actions in the scene
